Fights comparison type: options age_query_type (optional). weight Numeric. Filter weight kg (optional). weight_query_type Character. Weight comparison type: options age_query_type (optional). include_exhibitions Logical. Whether include exhibition matches counts (optional). boxer_id Integer. Filter specific boxer ID - return single boxer (optional). timeout Numeric. Request timeout seconds (default: 30).

title: Fetch boxers from BoxingBook API — fetch_boxingbook_boxers
text: function connects BoxingBook API retrieve boxer data comprehensive filtering capabilities. includes error handling network issues, API errors, malformed responses. API contains 25,000 boxer records detailed information including: Personal information (name, age, nationality, stance) Fight statistics (wins, losses, draws, exhibitions) Physical attributes (weight, calculated weight) Career details (gym, verification status, activity)

title: Fetch boxers from BoxingBook API — fetch_boxingbook_boxers
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Get first 50 boxers (default) boxers <- fetch_boxingbook_boxers()  # Search by name ali_boxers <- fetch_boxingbook_boxers(last_name = "Ali")  # Filter by country and gender aus_female <- fetch_boxingbook_boxers(   country = "Australia",   gender = "female" )  # Active boxers with more than 10 fights experienced <- fetch_boxingbook_boxers(   fights = 10,   fights_query_type = "GREATER_THAN" )  # Quick search across all name fields search_results <- fetch_boxingbook_boxers(quick_search = "Mike")  # Get specific boxer by ID (alternative to fetch_boxingbook_boxer) specific_boxer <- fetch_boxingbook_boxers(boxer_id = 30794)  # Heavyweights (over 90kg) heavyweights <- fetch_boxingbook_boxers(   weight = 90,   weight_query_type = "GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL" ) } # }
